slides.headline: A man is digging in a field that isn't his.
He finds treasure.
body: Buried. Forgotten. Worth more than everything he owns put together.

scripture.text: The kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

slides.headline: He sells everything.
body: House. Tools. Savings. All of it.
So he can buy one field that looks like every other field.

slides.headline: For joy.
body: Not reluctantly. Not as a sacrifice he'll resent later.
He was glad to do it. That is the whole point of the parable.

slides.headline: Now the other man.
body: Rich. Religious. Asks Jesus what he still lacks.
Told to sell what he has and come.

slides.headline: Same price. Opposite response.
body: One saw what he was getting. The other saw only what he was giving up.
slides.kicker: "He did not realise that it was eternal life, abundant life, that was calling him."

slides.headline: Which one sounds more like you?
body: Not a trick question. Most of us have been both.
slides.kicker: Full sermon on YouTube. Search Calvary Hephzibah.
